title: Càdlàg Solutions to Backward Stochastic Dynamics featuring Oblique Subgradients and driven by Martingale Noise
summary: The present study improves the qualitative analysis of backward stochastic variational dynamics on a general complete filtered probability space, considered in the spirit of Liang, Lyons and Qian (2011). Our primary objective is to overcome a substantial limitation in the study of Bensoussan, Li and Yam (2018), where the boundedness condition imposed on the multivalued subdifferential operator excludes standard obstacle-type constraints and indicator functions of convex sets.
